notes: NEW Times tab: log your meets and time trials and the app works out your PR, season best and wind-aided best for each event (55 m to 1600 m, hurdles, long, triple and high jump). Tailwinds above +2.0 m/s are kept as wind-aided and never count as a PR; hand times are converted to FAT (+0.24 s under 400 m, +0.14 s at 400 m and up) so a stopwatch time can't fake a PR. Includes a progression chart (higher = better), a goal tracker that shows the gap in seconds and percent, 200 m / 400 m split targets, and CSV export.
Fixed phones: every screen was about 55 px wider than the screen, so text and cards were cut off on the right edge. The layout now fits the phone width exactly.
